_comment: SilentScribe managed config. Host this file and put its RAW url in
.claude/.env as SILENTSCRIBE_CONFIG_URL, or in DEFAULT_CONFIG_URL in
NO API KEY GOES IN THIS FILE, and the extension will ignore one if present.
A key inside an extension is readable by anyone who installs it and shows in
the network panel of every machine that runs it, so each user enters their
own in Settings. This file only saves them typing the provider and model.
Every installed copy re-reads this once an hour, on browser start, and on
install. Unknown fields are ignored so it can grow safely. Delete _comment
Chrome does not auto-update an unpacked extension. 'version' and
'downloadUrl' drive an in-panel banner; installing stays a manual step.
